description: This file is a test script for the 'Article' controller in a web application, utilizing the Test2 framework and Coocook testing utilities. It performs a sequence of automated UI interactions and assertions to verify the functionality of article creation, updating, and validation.

classes.name: Test::Coocook
classes.description: A testing utility class providing methods for simulating user interactions and assertions in web application tests.

methods.name: new
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new Test::Coocook object.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP GET request to the specified path.

methods.name: login_ok
methods.description: Performs login with provided username and password, asserting success.

methods.name: follow_link_ok
methods.description: Follows a link identified by link text, asserting the link exists and is followed successfully.

methods.name: submit_form_ok
methods.description: Submits a form with specified fields, asserting the submission is successful.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Accesses the database schema object for querying.

methods.name: text_contains
methods.description: Asserts that the response content contains the specified text.

methods.name: submit_form_fails
methods.description: Submits a form expecting failure, used for validation testing.

methods.name: back
methods.description: Navigates back to the previous page.

methods.name: status_is
methods.description: Asserts that the HTTP response status matches the expected status.

methods.name: form_number
methods.description: Selects a form on the page by its number.

methods.name: tick
methods.description: Checks a checkbox input within a form.
